changes: Accepted grenade selections show the existing type icon and name for 1.6 seconds, with a persistent shoulder-type status alongside bomb status; repeated snapshots do not restart the popup.

MP5, AK-47, M4A1, M249, AWP and P90 support grabbing a seated magazine with offhand trigger or grip, pulling about 5.5 cm in its extraction direction, then releasing it. Pistols and tube-fed shotguns are excluded.
M249 cover and belt requirements remain; overlapping grab volumes choose magazine versus belt by proximity.

Removed magazines stay visible in the hand until release, then become bounded local debris. Chambered rounds and shared ammo accounting are preserved; existing magazine removal sounds and haptics apply.
Existing button ejection remains available. New grab/carry state is replicated and validated.
notes: Native render tests passed; existing shutdown resource/UID fallback warnings remain.
In-headset reach and comfort await player feedback.
